name: compact-change-skills
description: Six composable skills for shaping, auditing, specifying, planning, implementing, and independently verifying bounded software changes, with canonical-design artifact awareness and reusable execution of approved greenfield build slices.

interface.shortDescription: Run proportional workflows from quick to large changes
interface.longDescription: A repository-grounded workflow that keeps quick changes lightweight while adding audit, dependency, ownership, wave execution, context-control, canonical-design synchronization, and independent verification controls for bounded software changes. Its implementation and verification skills can also execute an approved greenfield build slice from software-design-skills.
defaultPrompt: Shape this change and choose the smallest safe workflow.
Audit this change without designing beyond repository evidence.
Plan and execute this change with bounded ownership and verification.
Independently verify the implementation against the frozen spec.
